author: Patrikano
body:
This appeal, only works if the guy who got me this warn is, Centralking

If it isn't, well shit... xD

So, let me start with a very nice and long story...

It all started when I kicked a few people from my team and they formed a new team called 'Aimbot'
Centralking joined with them and became leader of it,

At first they would keep asking to scrim cause they wanted to prove that they were indeed better than my team, so I accepted every time. We won easily every time and then they started acting like assholes to us so we began to be cocky and stuff.

So after this, we slowly took some players from their team who wanted to join us. and they disbanded.
After they disbanded they joined random teams and everything was calm...For a while...

Then we had kicked a few teammates, and AGAIN they made a team. The team is still alive, and they are called 'Ice cucumbers'
So, yeah. 

I invited Centralking to our team because I didn't want 'Ice cucumbers to become a huge threat, since they had already invited many of our players to their team, and I didn't want people to leave us. So I retaliated by inviting others from their team.

Centralking joined, for 1 hour max. Then he left, and his reason for it was something about 'false scrims' as you will see in screenshots I will show you later,

I then started asking him stuff, and he claimed that people from my past team talked shit about me and told him these things...
After that, when the walls tourney started, he began to constantly harass me by messaging 'do you think you can win this tourney?' when I replied 'yeah maybe' he would say stuff like 'lol sure..'

At a couple times, I got pissed so I had retaliated by telling him some stuff like 'fuck off stop talking to me'
But it was just to get him to stop, now I didn't see a point to screenshot half of these cause, well, I didn't think he'd report me -_-

Again, if this wasn't him, then I don't have much proof for the appeal, but i'm pretty sure it's him. If it isn't, count this as a report on him :/

Here's the proof of him being a jerk to me :/

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hey,

Two wrongs don't make a right. I got a few comments from a logcheck I requested on  you when you reported Zegita and the senior reported a few "fuck you"s here and there. I didn't realize you had actually said this much. I'm sorry, but the proper thing to do would've been to report him to staff and not attempt to be disrespectful as a way of retaliating. If you believe this was an unfair jurisdiction, feel free to escalate this appeal. Meanwhile, I'll go ahead and review the rest of the screenshots and take a look at Centralking.

Regards,
PresidentBadger

Hmm, So I got warned because of of zegita being salty and telling us to fuck off?

If this is the case, I will check what I said, since I recorded it all and see what happened, because to be honest, I don't remember saying much to him :/

but thanks anyways, I am sure I got mad at one point or another and probably did say, but we are all human, If I get punched. I won't go crying to my mom :/ I usually punch back

Thanks anyways for clearing it up,
Pat
